title: Rainy Festival Wreath
description: A woman with green hair adorned with blue and purple flowers stands in the rain holding a large red umbrella and a green floral wreath with a purple bow. She looks upward toward a large circular emblem in the sky containing a white dog silhouette surrounded by intricate white line drawings of scorpions and green foliage. A crowd of silhouetted figures fills the dark street below under a purple and blue rainy sky with glowing street lamps.
prompt: Surreal night scene of a woman with vibrant green hair decorated with blue and purple flowers, wearing all black and holding a large patterned red umbrella while carrying a circular green wreath with a purple bow. She stands on a wet cobblestone street looking up at a massive circular black emblem in the sky featuring a glowing white dog silhouette at its center, surrounded by white line-art scorpions and green leaves. Rain falls over a dense crowd of black silhouetted people holding umbrellas, with glowing street lamps and a dramatic purple and blue sky.
